physical_spec_and_typography.font_family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

layout_description: Use five evenly spaced vertical phase cards across a single horizontal timeline. Each phase has its relative-month header in navy, a thin blue divider, and three separate short Chinese task lines. Connect only adjacent phase cards with small rightward arrows along a single level. Beneath all phases place one wide white annotation strip with the tentative-period header and contract qualification. The sequence is a proposed research schedule: do not add completion checkmarks, percentages, approval stamps, or calendar dates. Keep all five cards identical in width and height. Make the annotation as legible as the task labels, with sufficient bottom margin.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: 项目按资料建议采用\textbf{【暂定 自正式启动起12个月】}的研究周期。正式起止日期及合同要求以\textbf{【待补 F-KS-05：资助起止日期和结题成果要求】}为准。以下月份为相对启动月份，依据三项研究内容的依赖关系安排，不预先写成已批准的日历日期。
